create_project_new: create a new LiteLLM project with budget, team, models, and object permission settings
update_project_settings: update an existing LiteLLM project with new budget, models, metadata, or object permission
delete_project_by_ids: delete one or more LiteLLM projects after verifying no associated API keys remain
get_project_info: get detailed information about a specific LiteLLM project including budget and permissions
list_user_projects: list all LiteLLM projects accessible to the authenticated user or proxy admin
